scope: All work/ocr_text JSON texts searched for part-number labels, five-digit-hyphen-five-character codes, long numeric identifiers and alphanumeric hyphen codes; strong candidates and replacement statements were visually checked against source page images.
conclusion: No actual orderable vehicle replacement part number was confirmed in the supplied maintenance-manual material. Three matching Hyundai-like identifiers are explicitly special-tool numbers. This is an evidence-bounded finding, not proof of absence in every image because OCR can miss text.
